ayuda: A running number like "Programa 31 | Video 2" on every post. The show number goes up with each episode and the video number restarts at 1 in each show.
formatoInvalido: Use at least one variable: '{programa}', '{video}' or '{publicacion}'.

dondeOpciones.texto: At the start of the text

portadaAyuda: It goes as the first line of the brand cover title (the brand cover must be on).
siguienteProgramaAyuda: The next episode you schedule takes it.
videoAyuda: The video number is set when scheduling: the first one out of each show is 1. When scheduling you can change that clip's numbers.

delClip.programaAyuda: Changes it for every clip of this episode.
delClip.sinPrograma: This clip has no episode: the format can't be built.
